notes.title: Adding new features
notes.content:
As nothing is more important to us than taking into consideration the expectations of players, we have developed new features taking into account your suggestions, in order to make your gaming experience even more satisfying.

[list]
[*] [b]Dash to the left:[/b] left bumper button.
[*] [b]Dash to the right:[/b] right bumper button.
[*] [b]Lowering the camera:[/b] right stick down, or right arrow + A button.
[*] [b]Smooth camera:[/b] can be activated or deactivated in the Options menu.
[*] [b]Integration of a summary screen of your achievements[/b]: accessible from the main screen.
[*] [b]3 Speedrun trophies:[/b] depending on the difficulty level.
[*] [b]Viewing game time per level:[/b] in the level selection screen, using the X button.
[/list]

[h2]Game OST[/h2]
You can also find the game OST album, on your favorite streaming platform.
Linktree:
[url=https://argolabgames.com/index.php/extras/]https://argolabgames.com/index.php/extras/[/url]
